references.populationDefinition: All four provisional crop windows in each year 2015–2024, zero calendar shift: 40 distinct crop-years, independent of candidate order and eligibility. Bounds fixed for shifted-window diagnostics; clip to [0,1].

limitations: Reduced heat-only model: precipitation is omitted from this calculation; no drought or combined climate recommendation.
Illustrative ≥35°C threshold and provisional crop windows, not crop-specific damage calibration.
Equal weight to each of five crop positions; not area-, yield- or profit-weighted.
Six overlapping windows are historical replays, not independent statistical samples.
Minimum two common scenarios is an author comparison convention, not a statistical confidence threshold.
Unknown soil, disease, management and previous crops keep all plans conditional.
